rationale: PINS the fleet MIXIN RULING (2026-10-19): a class extends ONE superclass (Base) and mixes traits in via `with` (Contract) — Scala's with-clause composition publishes `extends` for position 0 and `mixes_in` for every further supertype, exactly like Dart `with` and Ruby include/extend/prepend. `implements` is RULED NOT-APPLICABLE for scala.
